title: King's Gambit Declined: Classical Variation
line: Black does not take: its bishop stops White's king from castling on the short side.

steps.text: Black does not take the pawn. Its bishop aims at g1, so your king cannot castle on that side.
Bring the knight out. Leave the pawn on e5 for now.

wrong.f4e5: The queen checks on h4. After a pawn blocks, she takes on e4 with check and then your rook.

also.b1c3: That is also played. This lesson brings the other knight out.

steps.after: Black guards its pawn. Your knight now keeps the queen off h4.

steps.text: Move the pawn on c2 one square. It gets ready for a pawn on d4 that chases the bishop.

also.f4e5: Taking now is also played. This lesson gets the pawn on d4 ready.
also.b1c3: That is also played. This lesson gets the pawn on d4 ready.

steps.text: Push the pawn in front of your queen two squares. It attacks the bishop.

also.f4e5: Taking first is also played. This lesson pushes the pawn.

steps.text: Take back with the pawn on c3, so two of your pawns stand in the center.
Bring the other knight out to guard the pawn on e4.
steps.after: Two pawns in the center and the bishop pushed back. Your king can now get ready to castle.

summary: Black keeps the bishop on the line to the king's castling square. White builds the center to push it back.
